g:Label.text: The gate: a stream's shape is its value of the learning key, and a shape with a rule below is served by it. One with none waits while a session learns one.

form:FormGroup.label: Learning mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the stage may call the model at all. Disabled by default; Shapeshifter AI is opt-in per document. Disabled still routes to the rules already bound, and errors a shape that has none.

form:FormGroup.label: Learning key
form:FormGroup.helpText: The fields a learned rule binds on and the model is shown, in order: Feed, Type, a receipt header such as Format or System, or Shape Signature. A shape is one value of this key. Feed and Type by default; add Shape Signature where one feed carries several kinds of record. A stream that lacks a value for a key field is not learned.

form:FormGroup.label: Maximum deferral age (ms)
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a stream may wait on a learning session before it is raised in the Supervisor's backlog. It goes on waiting; this is the flag that says somebody should look.
